arabic_text: وَكَمْ مِنْ ذنْبِ غَطَّيْتَهُ عَلَيَّ فَلَمْ تَشْهَرْنِي،
transliteration: wa kam min dhanbin ghataitahu ʿalayya fa lam tashharni
english_text: How many of my sins Thou hast cloaked without making me notorious!

arabic_text: وَكَمْ مِنْ شَائِبَة أَلْمَمْتُ بِهَا فَلَمْ تَهْتِكْ عَنِّي سِتْرَهَا، وَلَمْ تُقَلِّدْنِي مَكْرُوهَ شَنَارِهَا، وَلَمْ تُبْدِ سَوْأَتِهَا لِمَنْ يَلْتَمِسُ مَعَايِبِي مِنْ جِيْرَتِي، وَحَسَدَةِ نِعْمَتِكَ عِنْدِي،
transliteration: wa kam min sha'ibah almmamtu biha falam tahtik anni sitraha walam tuqallidni makrooha shanariha walam tubdi sawʾatihā liman yaltamisu maʿāyibī min jīratī wa ḥasadati niʿmatika ʿindī
english_text: How many faults I have committed, yet Thou didst not tear away from me their covering, collar me with their detested disgrace, or make their dishonour plain to those of my neighbours who search for my defects and to those who envy Thy favour toward me!

arabic_text: ثُمَّ لَمْ يَنْهَنِي ذَلِكَ عَنْ أَنْ جَرَيْتُ إلَى سُوءِ مَا عَهِدْتَ مِنّي
transliteration: thumma lam yanhanī dhālika ʿan ʾan jaraytu ilá suʾi mā ʿahidta minnī
english_text: But that did not prevent me from passing on to the evil that Thou knowest from me!

arabic_text: فَمَنْ أَجْهَلُ مِنِّي يَا إلهِيْ بِرُشْدِهِ
transliteration: faman ajhallu minni yā ilāhī bi rusdihī
english_text: So who is more ignorant than I, my God, of his own right conduct?

arabic_text: وَمَنْ أَغْفَلُ مِنِّي عَنْ حَظِّهِ
transliteration: wa-man ʾaghflu minni ʿan ḥazzihi
english_text: Who is more heedless than I of his own good fortune?

arabic_text: وَمَنْ أَبْعَدُ مِنِّي مِنِ اسْتِصْلاَحِ نَفْسِهِ
transliteration: wa man abʿadu minni min istiṣlāḥi nafsihi
english_text: Who is further than I from seeking to set himself right?

arabic_text: حِيْنَ اُنْفِقُ مَا أَجْرَيْتَ عَلَيَّ مِنْ رِزْقِكَ فِيمَا نَهَيْتَنِي عَنْهُ مِنْ مَعْصِيَتِكَ
transliteration: ḥīna unfiqu mā ʾajrayta ʿalayya min rizqika fīmā nahaytanī ʿanhū min maʿṣiyatika
english_text: For I spend the provision Thou deliverest to me in the disobedience Thou hast prohibited to me!

arabic_text: وَمَنْ أَبْعَدُ غَوْراً فِي الْبَاطِلِ وَأَشَدُّ إقْدَاماً عَلَى السُّوءِ مِنّي
transliteration: wa-man abʿadu ghauran fil-batili wa-ashaddu iqdadama ʿalas-soui minni
english_text: Who sinks more deeply into falsehood and is more intensely audacious in evil than I?

arabic_text: حِينَ أَقِفُ بَيْنَ دَعْوَتِكَ وَدَعْوَةِ الشَّيْطَانِ، فَـأتَّبعُ دَعْوَتَهُ عَلَى غَيْرِ عَمىً مِنّي فِيْ مَعْرِفَة بِهِ، وَلا نِسْيَان مِنْ حِفْظِي لَهُ وَأَنَا حِينَئِذ مُوقِنٌ بِأَنَّ مُنْتَهَى دَعْوَتِكَ إلَى الْجَنَّةِ وَمُنْتَهَى دَعْوَتِهِ إلَى النَّارِ
transliteration: ḥīna ʾaqifu bayna daʿwatika wa daʿwat al-shayṭān fa'ttabiʿu daʿwatahu ʿala ghayri ʿammin minni fi maʿrifati bihi wa lā nisyān min ḥifẓī lahū wa anā ḥīnaḏi muqinun bi-anna muntaḥā daʿwatika ilā al-jannati wa muntaḥā daʿwatihi ilā al-nār
english_text: For I hesitate between Thy call and the call of Satan and then follow his call without being blind in my knowledge of him or forgetful in my memory of him, while I am certain that Thy call takes to the Garden and his call takes to the Fire!

arabic_text: سُبْحَانَكَ مَا أَعْجَبَ مَا أَشْهَدُ بِهِ عَلَى نَفْسِي وَاُعَدِّدُهُ مِنْ مَكْتُوْمِ أَمْرِي،
transliteration: subḥānaka mā aʿjaba mā ash hadu bih ʿalā nafsī wa uʿaddiduhu min maktūm amrī
english_text: Glory be to Thee! How marvellous the witness I bear against my own soul and the enumeration of my own hidden affairs!

arabic_text: وَأَعْجَبُ مِنْ ذلِكَ أَنَاتُكَ عَنِّي وَإبْطآؤُكَ عَنْ مُعَاجَلَتِي وَلَيْسَ ذلِكَ مِنْ كَرَمِي عَلَيْكَ بَلْ تَأَنِّياً مِنْكَ لِي، وَتَفَضُّلاً مِنْكَ عَلَيَّ،
transliteration: wa'aʿjabu min dhālika ʾanātuka ʿannī wa-ibtāʾuka ʿan muʿājalatī wa-laysa dhālika min karamī ʿalayka bal taʾanniyān minka lī wa tafadhdhulan minka ʿalayya
english_text: And more marvellous than that is Thy lack of haste with me, Thy slowness in attending to me! That is not because I possess honour with Thee, but because Thou waitest patiently for me and art bountiful toward me

arabic_text: لانْ أَرْتَـدِعَ عَنْ مَعْصِيَتِكَ الْمُسْخِطَةِ وَاُقْلِعَ عَنْ سَيِّئَـاتِي الْمُخْلِقَةِ .
transliteration: lan artaḍiʿa ʿan maʿṣiyatikal mukhṭiṭah wa uqliaʿa ʿan sayyiāti al-mukhliqaẗi
english_text: that I may refrain from disobedience displeasing to Thee and abstain from evil deeds that disgrace me,

arabic_text: وَلاَِنَّ عَفْوَكَ عَنّي أَحَبُّ إلَيْكَ مِنْ عُقُوبَتِي،
transliteration: walānna ʿafwaka ʿanni aḥabbu ilayka min ʿuqūbatī
english_text: and because Thou lovest to pardon me more than to punish!

arabic_text: بَلْ أَنَا يَا إلهِي أكْثَرُ ذُنُوباً وَأَقْبَحُ آثاراً وَأَشْنَعُ أَفْعَالاً وَأَشَدُّ فِي الْباطِلِ تَهَوُّراً وَأَضْعَفُ عِنْدَ طَاعَتِكَ تَيَقُّظاً،
transliteration: bal anā yā ilāhī aktharu dhunūban wa-aqbahu atharan wa-ashna'u afa'alan wa ashaddu fil-baatili tahawwuran wa'adʿafu ʿinda ṭāʿatika tayyaqquẓan
english_text: But I, my God, am more numerous in sins, uglier in footsteps, more repulsive in acts, more reckless in rushing into falsehood, weaker in awakening to Thy obedience,

arabic_text: وَأَقَلُّ لِوَعِيْدِكَ انْتِبَاهاً وَارْتِقَاباً مِنْ أَنْ أُحْصِيَ لَكَ عُيُوبِي، أَوْ أَقْدِرَ عَلَى ذِكْرِ ذُنُوبِي
transliteration: wa'aqallu liwaa'idika intibaahan waartiqabaan min an uḥṣiya laka ʿuyūbī ʾaw ʾaqdira ʿalā ḏikri ḏunūbī
english_text: and less attentive and heedful toward Thy threats, than that I could number for Thee my faults or have the power to recount my sins.

arabic_text: وَإنَّمَا أُوبِّخُ بِهَذا نَفْسِي طَمَعَـاً فِي رَأْفَتِكَ الَّتِي بِهَـا صَلاَحُ أَمْرِ الْمُذْنِبِينَ، وَرَجَاءً لِرَحْمَتِكَ الَّتِي بِهَا فَكَاكُ رِقَابِ الْخَاطِئِينَ.
transliteration: wa innamā ʾūbbikhu bihādhā nafsī ṭamaʿan fī raʾfatika al-latī bihā ṣalāḥu amr al-mudhnibīn wa rajāʾan li-raḥmatika allatī bihā fakāku riqābi al-khāṭi'īn
english_text: I only scold my own soul, craving Thy gentleness, through which the affairs of sinners are set right, and hoping for Thy mercy, through which the necks of the offenders are freed.

arabic_text: اللَّهُمَّ وَهَذِهِ رَقَبَتِي قَدْ أَرَقَّتْهَا الذُّنُوبُ، فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ وَأَعْتِقْهَا بِعَفْوِكَ،
transliteration: allāhumma wa hādhīhi raqabatī qad araqqathāl-dhunūb fa ṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa ālihī wa aʿtiq-hā biʿafwik
english_text: O God, this is my neck, enslaved by sins, so bless Muhammad and his Household and release it through Thy pardon!

arabic_text: وَهَذَا ظَهْرِي قَدْ أَثْقَلَتْهُ الْخَطَايَـا، فَصَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ وَخَفِّفْ عَنْهُ بِمَنِّكَ.
transliteration: wa-ha-dhaa ẓa-h-ri qad ath-qa-lat-hu al-kha-taayaa fa salli ʿalā muḥammadin wa ālihi wa khaffif ʿanhū bimannika
english_text: This is my back, weighed down by offenses, so bless Muhammad and his Household and lighten it through Thy kindness!

arabic_text: يَا إلهِي لَوْ بَكَيْتُ إلَيْكَ حَتَّى تَسْقُطَ أَشْفَارُ عَيْنَيَّ ، وَانْتَحَبْتُ حَتَّى يَنْقَطِعَ صَوْتِي، وَقُمْتُ لَكَ حَتَّى تَتَنَشَّرَ قَدَمَايَ، وَرَكَعْتُ لَكَ حَتَّى يَنْخَلِعَ صُلْبِي،
transliteration: yā ʾilahī law bakaytu ʾilayka ḥattā tasquṭa ʾashfāru ʿaynayya wa-antahabtu hatta yanqati' a-sawti wa qumtu laka hatta tatanaššara qadāmayā wa rakʿatu laka hatta yankhaliʿa ṣulbi
english_text: My God, were I to weep to Thee until my eyelids drop off, wail until my voice wears out, stand before Thee until my feet swell up, bow to Thee until my backbone is thrown out of joint,

arabic_text: وَسَجَدْتُ لَكَ حَتَّى تَتَفَقَّأَ حَدَقَتَايَ، وَأكَلْتُ تُرَابَ الأرْضِ طُولَ عُمْرِي، وَشَرِبْتُ مَاءَ الرَّمَادِ آخِرَ دَهْرِي وَذَكَرْتُكَ فِي خِلاَلِ ذَلِكَ حَتَّى يَكِلَّ لِسَانِي
transliteration: wa sajjadtu laka hatta tatafaqqa'a hadaqatay. wa-akaltu turaba al-ardhi tūla ʿumrī wa sharibtu mā'a ar-ramādi ākhira dahri wa dhakartuka fi khilali dhalika hatta yakilla lisani
english_text: prostrate to Thee until my eyeballs fall out, eat the dirt of the earth for my whole life, drink the water of ashes till the end of my days, mention Thee through all of that until my tongue fails,

arabic_text: ثُمَّ لَمْ أَرْفَعْ طَرْفِي إلَى آفَاقِ السَّمَاءِ اسْتِحْيَاءً مِنْكَ مَا اسْتَوْجَبْتُ بِذَلِكَ مَحْوَ سَيِّئَة وَاحِـدَة مِنْ سَيِّئـاتِي،
transliteration: thumma lam arfaʿ tarfī ilā āfāqi l-samā'i istiḥyā'an minka mā ʾastawjabtu bidhalika maḥwa sayyiʾatin wāḥidatin min sayyiātī.
english_text: and not lift my glance to the sky's horizons in shame before Thee, yet would I not merit through all of that the erasing of a single one of my evil deeds!

arabic_text: وَإنْ كُنْتَ تَغْفِـرُ لِي حِيْنَ أَسْتَوْجِبُ مَغْفِرَتَكَ وَتَعْفُو عَنِّي حِينَ أَسْتَحِقُّ عَفْوَكَ فَإنَّ ذَلِكَ غَيْرُ وَاجِب لِيْ بِاسْتِحْقَاق، وَلا أَنَا أَهْلٌ لَهُ بِـاسْتِيجَاب
transliteration: wa in kuntata ghfiru li hina astawjibu maghfirataka wa ta'fu ʿannī hīna astaḥiqqu ʿafwaka fa'innadhalika ghayru wajib li bi-istihaqaaq wa la ana ahlun lahu bi-istiijab
english_text: Though Thou forgivest me when I merit Thy forgiveness and pardonest me when I deserve Thy pardon, yet I have no title to that through what I deserve, nor am I worthy of it through merit,

arabic_text: إذْ كَـانَ جَزَائِي مِنْكَ فِي أَوَّلِ مَا عَصَيْتُكَ النَّارَ;
transliteration: 'idh kāna jazā'ī minka fī 'awwali mā 'aṣaytuka alnār.'
english_text: since my repayment from Thee from the first that I disobeyed Thee is the Fire!

arabic_text: فَإنْ تُعَذِّبْنِي، فَأَنْتَ غَيْرُ ظَالِم لِيْ.
transliteration: fa'in tuʿaẓẓibnī, fa'anta ghayru ẓālim lī
english_text: So if Thou punishest me, Thou dost me no wrong.

arabic_text: إلهِي فَـإذْ قَـدْ تَغَمَّـدْتَنِي بِسِتْـرِكَ فَلَمْ تَفْضَحْنِي وَتَـأَنَّيْتَنِي بِكَـرَمِـكَ فَلَمْ تُعَـاجِلْنِي، َو حَلُمْتَ عَنِّي بِتَفَضُّلِكَ فَلَمْ تُغَيِّـرْ نِعْمَتَـكَ عَلَيَّ، وَلَمْ تُكَـدِّرْ مَعْرُوفَكَ عِنْدِي
transliteration: ilāhī fa'in qad taghammadtanī bisiṭrik fa-lam tafḍaḥnī wa taʾannaytanī bika-ramika fa-lam tuʿājilnī wa halumta anni bi tafadhdhulika falam tughayyir ni'mataka 'alayya wa lam tukaddir ma'rufaka 'indi
english_text: My God, since Thou hast shielded me with Thy covering and not exposed me, waited patiently for me through Thy generosity, and not hurried me to punishment, and shown me clemency through Thy bounty, and not changed Thy favour upon me or muddied Thy kindly acts toward me,

arabic_text: فَارْحَمْ طُولَ تَضَرُّعِيْ وَشِـدَّةَ مَسْكَنَتِي وَسُوءَ مَوْقِفِيْ.
transliteration: farham ṭūla taḍarruʿī wa shiddat masḳanatī wa suʾa maqfī
english_text: have mercy on my drawn out pleading, my intense misery, and my evil situation!

arabic_text: اللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلَى مُحَمَّد وَآلِهِ وَقِنِي مِنَ الْمَعَاصِي وَاسْتَعْمِلْنِي بِالطَّاعَةِ، وَارْزُقْنِي حُسْنَ الإِنابَةِ وَطَهِّرْنِي بِالتَّـوْبَةِ، وَأَيِّـدْنِي بِالْعِصْمَةِ وَاسْتَصْلِحْنِي بِالْعَافِيَةِ
transliteration: allāhumma ṣalli ʿalā muḥammad wa ālih wa qinī min al-maʿāṣī wa stacmilnī biṭ-ṭāʿah warzuqni husna al'inabati watahhirni bittawbah wa-ayyidnī bil-ʿiṣmah wa-istaghlinī bil-ʿāfiyah
english_text: O God, bless Muhammad and his Household, protect me from acts of disobedience, employ me in obedience, provide me with excellent turning back [to Thee], purify me through repentance, strengthen me through preservation from sin, set me right through well being,

arabic_text: وَأَذِقْنِي حَلاَوَةَ الْمَغْفِـرَةِ، وَاجْعَلْنِي طَلِيقَ عَفْـوِكَ، وَعَتِيقَ رَحْمَتِكَ وَاكْتُبْ لِي أَمَاناً مِنْ سَخَطِكَ
transliteration: wa-athiqni halawat al-maghfirah wajʿalni ṭalīqa ʿafwik, waʿatīqa raḥmatik wa-ktub li amanan min sakhatika
english_text: let me taste the sweetness of forgiveness, make me the freedman of Thy pardon and the slave released by Thy mercy, and write for me a security from Thy displeasure!

arabic_text: وَبَشِّرْنِي بِذلِكَ فِي الْعَاجِلِ دُونَ الآجِلِ بُشْرى أَعْرِفُهَا وَعَرِّفْنِي فِيهِ عَلاَمَةً أَتَبَيَّنُهَا
transliteration: wa bashshirny bi dhalika fil-ʿajil doona al-ʾajil bushran aʿrifuhā wa'arifni feehi 'alaamatan atabayyanuha
english_text: Give me the good news of that in the immediate, not the deferred - a good news I recognize - and make known to me therein a sign which I may clearly see!

arabic_text: إنَّ ذلِكَ لاَ يَضيقُ عَلَيْكَ فِي وُسْعِكَ ، وَلا يَتَكَأَّدُكَ فِي قُدْرَتِكَ، وَلا يَتَصَعَّدُكَ فِي أناتِكَ ، وَلا يَؤودُك فِي جَزِيلِ هِباتِكَ الَّتِي دَلَّتْ عَلَيْهَا آيَاتُكَ
transliteration: inna dhalika la yadīqu ʿalayka fī wusʿika wa lā yatakaddaduka fī qudratika wa lā yatasʿadduka fī anātika walā yauwuduka fī jazīli hībātika allatī dallat ʿalayhā āyātuka
english_text: That will not constrain Thee in Thy plenty, distress Thee in Thy power, ascend beyond Thy lack of haste, or tire Thee in Thy great gifts, which are pointed to by Thy signs.
